laws.rule: Durango bans storing, distributing, selling and drinking alcohol on the public road and in places such as parks, plazas, schools, temples, cemeteries, theatres and fairs (Ley para el Control de Bebidas con Contenido Alcohólico, art. 45). Councils can suspend sales on set days and hours, and sales stop on days set by federal or local electoral law (art. 33). Text held on OJN, last reform 25 August 2013.
